question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Quick-witted
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Foolish)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Quick-witted"** means having or showing the ability to think and respond quickly and effectively. (तेज़ दिमाग वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** The quick-witted student answered the teacher's tricky question without hesitation.
 
 
 
• **"Foolish"** refers to someone lacking good sense or judgment; someone who acts unwisely. (मूर्ख)
 
 
• **Example:** It was foolish of him to invest all his money in a risky business without proper research.
 
 
 
• Since "Foolish" is the opposite of "Quick-witted," it is the most appropriate antonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Foolish)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Brave** (बहादुर): Someone who shows courage and is not afraid of facing danger or difficulties.

 
 
• **Example:** The brave firefighter risked his life to save the trapped family.
 
 
 
• **Kind** (दयालु): Someone who is generous and considerate towards others.
 
 
• **Example:** She is known for her kind nature and willingness to help those in need.
 
 
 
• **Patient** (धैर्यवान): Someone who can remain calm and not get annoyed, especially in a difficult situation.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor was patient with his elderly patients, explaining everything carefully.
